For business · Cafés · Shops · Gyms

Your regulars, now with a Ger to come back to.

Nutag is a collecting game played at real places in Ulaanbaatar. When your place becomes an Ortoo, customers get one part of a Ger on each day they order with you. A Ger raised at your Ortoo keeps standing for as long as its owner keeps coming back.

Open the console

Free to join · No cut of your sales

The Ortoo were the relay stations of the Mongol Empire, where messengers rested and changed horses. Your place, where people stop on their way and keep coming back, is one too.

How it works

One part a day, one more reason to come back.

  1. 1.0 — Today here

    Today's part

    Your Ortoo gives one part of a Ger each day and works through all eight in eight days. Customers see today's part and tomorrow's before they order.

  2. 2.0 — Order

    An approved order

    A customer's first approved order of the day at your place earns them that part. An order is approved when they pay in the app, or when your staff approve it. However much they buy, it's one part a day.

  3. 3.0 — Ger

    Raise a Ger

    Once they have all eight parts, a customer taps “Raise a Ger” at the Ortoo they choose. A Ger raised at your Ortoo keeps standing while its owner keeps ordering from you.

What you get

A free page and menu, and no cut of your sales.

  • Customers who come back

    A Ger only stands while its owner keeps ordering at that Ortoo, so someone with a Ger at your place has a reason to drop by again.

  • You set the window

    You decide how long a Ger stands without a visit. Leave it as it is and that's 7 days. A barbershop people visit once a month can make it longer, or make Gers that never fall. It can't be shorter than 7 days.

  • A free page and menu

    Name, logo, banner, brand colours, a short promo, opening hours, menu and photo drive, all set by you in the console. All of it free.

  • On the map

    Your Ortoo shows on the app's map and in the “Around here” list. People looking for the part they need today can find you too.

  • No cut

    Nutag never takes a cut of your sales. Payments in the app go straight to your own Bonum or Stripe account.

  • A ladder you write

    Write your own rewards for how many of a customer's Gers stand at your place, say a free coffee at 3 Gers. The app only counts; you honour the reward at your counter.

  • Honest stories

    Only someone with an approved order at your place can post a story: a rating, a few words, up to 5 photos or one video of up to 15 seconds. A fresh story with a photo or video sits in the story ring for 24 hours. You can't hide or delete it, and that's why people trust it.

  • Table cards

    A customer scans the QR code on the table, or touches the NFC card with their phone, and orders from their seat, even without the app. The order lands on your till. We'll see together on the call whether they suit your place.

At the counter

Approve orders in the console, or on the app's till.

If you take payment in the app, an order approves itself the moment the money lands. If not, it waits on your till, and your staff approve it in the console or on the app's till. On the app's till they can also note whether it was paid in cash, by card or by transfer.

Questions

Good to know

Does it cost anything?

No. Your page, your menu and your spot on the map are free, and Nutag never takes a cut of your sales. The one thing you can buy, if you want it, is featured placement: your Ortoo at the top of the list, under a “Featured” tag.

So how does Nutag make money?

From advertisers and from featured placement. None of it comes out of your sales.

Does every order give a part?

No. A customer gets one part a day at your place, with their first approved order. A second order that day is just an order: it reaches your till as usual and gives no part.

When does a Ger fall?

When its owner has had no approved order at your place for the window you set. That's 7 days unless you change it; it can be longer, or never, but never shorter than 7. Two days before, the app marks the Ger as falling, and on Android a notification says so too. If it does fall, the owner keeps 7 of the 8 parts; only the Uni is lost. Nobody can knock down someone else's Ger.

Do I have to take payment in the app?

No. With your own Bonum or Stripe account you can take payment in the app. Without one, customers pay at the counter and your staff approve the order. Up to ten orders from one customer can wait at your place for approval.

Where do customers raise their Gers?

At any Ortoo, once they have all eight parts, one Ger per Ortoo per day. Raising a Ger takes only the parts, with no order needed that day. Every new player starts with one of each part, so their first Ger can go up right away. A Ger at your place keeps standing only while they keep ordering from you.

Can I remove a bad story?

No. Only people with an approved order at your place can post, one story each. The rating is one of four: Disliked, Okay, Liked or Favorite. You can't hide or delete a story, and that's why people trust them. Stories give no part, and they don't change where you appear in the list.

Do table cards work everywhere?

They're switched on place by place. We'll decide together on the call whether they suit yours.

What do my customers need?

The Nutag app from the App Store or Google Play, and a phone number to sign in with an SMS code. That's all.
